## Setting
Rearranging the office seating. A team of five has outgrown the way its desks were originally placed, and the layout is being settled before the floor is reorganized. All five will sit in whatever is decided. Participants: Daisuke, Mio, Shunichi, Toshio and Shizue. Each participant has a concern of their own, which the others do not know.

- Facilities quote for re-running power and network
- Basis of the department's floor billing
- Morning routine on the pilot floor upstairs
- Unplanned seat shuffles in the past year
- Sound meter readings across the room
- Physio's note from the workstation check
- Drawn plan against the staff survey
- Arrival times in the badge records
- Two project strands within earshot last spring
- What this year's two joiners reported

|---|---|---|---|

Name: Daisuke
Age: 16
Gender: male
Personality: Daisuke is very introverted and cautious, and tends to be somewhat passive when interacting with others. Age: 17
Gender: female

Age: 32
Gender: male

Name: Toshio
Age: 28
Gender: male
Personality: Toshio has a calm and calculating personality and does not often show his emotions. He has a strong will and is the type of person who steadily moves toward his goals. Occasionally, he observes things with a sharp gaze and has the ability to quickly assess situations. As a result, he is trusted by others as a reliable presence, but he is cautious about getting deeply involved with others. It seems that he has experienced some pain or suffering in his past, but he rarely shows it to others, and those scars may be connected to his cold-hearted side.
Concern: Whatever we agree will hand some people a better place to sit than others, and as things stand that has never once been said out loud. I would rather we decided who carries the worse end of it than let it fall out of habit.

Name: Shizue
Age: 78
Gender: female
Personality: Shizue has a very calm and gentle personality. Even as she has grown older, she continues to smile warmly at those around her and is a very caring person.
